spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od4m2p5t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Stations == {"presoak","brushes","dryer"}

VARIABLES vote, crashed, decision, wash

TypeOK ==
    /\ vote \in [Stations -> {"none","yes","no"}]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Stations
    /\ decision \in {"none","commit","abort"}
    /\ wash \in {"idle","running","done"}

Init ==
    /\ vote = [s \in Stations |-> "none"]
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ wash = "idle"

Vote(s) ==
    /\ s \notin crashed
    /\ vote[s] = "none"
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ \E v \in {"yes","no"} : vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![s] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, decision, wash>>

Crash(s) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ s \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, decision, wash>>

DecideCommit ==
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ \A s \in Stations : vote[s] = "yes"
    /\ decision' = "commit"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, crashed, wash>>

DecideAbort ==
    /\ decision = "none"
    /\ (\E s \in Stations : vote[s] = "no") \/ crashed # {}
    /\ \A s \in Stations : (s \in crashed \/ vote[s] # "none")
    /\ decision' = "abort"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, crashed, wash>>

StartWash ==
    /\ decision = "commit"
    /\ wash = "idle"
    /\ wash' = "running"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, crashed, decision>>

FinishWash ==
    /\ wash = "running"
    /\ wash' = "done"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, crashed, decision>>

Done ==
    /\ (decision = "abort" \/ wash = "done")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, crashed, decision, wash>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Stations : Vote(s)
    \/ \E s \in Stations : Crash(s)
    \/ DecideCommit
    \/ DecideAbort
    \/ StartWash
    \/ FinishWash
    \/ Done

WashSafe == (wash \in {"running","done"}) => (decision = "commit")
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT WashSafe
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line runs a two-phase commit before physically starting a wash
cycle. A coordinator asks each station (pre-soak, brushes, dryer) to prepare; every station
that has not silently crashed votes yes or no. If all stations voted yes the coordinator
decides commit; if any station voted no OR any station has crashed silently, the coordinator
decides abort. Only after a commit decision may the conveyor physically START the wash
(an irreversible action that engages the drive chain), and once started it later FINISHES.
Any single station may crash silently at any time, contributing no vote thereafter.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the conveyor is never running or finished a wash unless the coordinator
had actually decided to commit.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od11m9p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Workers == {"i1","i2"}
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES epoch, known, grant, spooled

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ known \in [Workers -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ grant \subseteq Workers
    /\ spooled \subseteq (Workers \X (0..MaxEpoch))

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ known = [w \in Workers |-> 0]
    /\ grant = {}
    /\ spooled = {}

Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ grant' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<known, spooled>>

Refresh(w) ==
    /\ known[w] # epoch
    /\ known' = [known EXCEPT ![w] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, grant, spooled>>

Grantt(w) ==
    /\ known[w] = epoch
    /\ w \notin grant
    /\ grant' = grant \cup {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, known, spooled>>

Spool(w) ==
    /\ w \in grant
    /\ known[w] = epoch
    /\ spooled' = spooled \cup {<<w, epoch>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, known, grant>>

Done ==
    /\ epoch = MaxEpoch
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, known, grant, spooled>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Refresh(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Grantt(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Spool(w)
    \/ Done

GrantFresh == \A w \in grant : known[w] = epoch
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT GrantFresh
nl:
A print shop runs two independent spooler instances that share one physical printer pool.
To coordinate, the shop uses epoch-numbered reconfiguration: a configuration manager bumps a
global epoch whenever membership changes, and bumping the epoch immediately revokes every
outstanding print grant. A worker instance must first REFRESH to learn the current epoch, then
it may be GRANTED spooling rights only while its known epoch matches the global epoch, and it may
SPOOL a job only while it holds a grant at the current epoch. A reconfiguration may happen at any
time, leaving any worker that has not refreshed stale.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every worker that currently holds a spooling grant knows the current epoch, so no
stale worker can act.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od18m2p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Instances == {"a","b"}
Slots == {"s1","s2"}

VARIABLES prepared, owner, decision

TypeOK ==
    /\ prepared \in [Slots -> Instances \cup {"none"}]
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Instances \cup {"none"}]
    /\ decision \in [Slots -> {"none","commit","abort"}]

Init ==
    /\ prepared = [s \in Slots |-> "none"]
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> "none"]
    /\ decision = [s \in Slots |-> "none"]

Prepare(i, s) ==
    /\ prepared[s] = "none"
    /\ owner[s] = "none"
    /\ decision[s] = "none"
    /\ prepared' = [prepared EXCEPT ![s] = i]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, decision>>

Commit(s) ==
    /\ prepared[s] # "none"
    /\ decision[s] = "none"
    /\ decision' = [decision EXCEPT ![s] = "commit"]
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = prepared[s]]
    /\ UNCHANGED prepared

Abort(s) ==
    /\ prepared[s] # "none"
    /\ decision[s] = "none"
    /\ decision' = [decision EXCEPT ![s] = "abort"]
    /\ prepared' = [prepared EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED owner

Reopen(s) ==
    /\ decision[s] = "abort"
    /\ decision' = [decision EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prepared, owner>>

Done ==
    /\ \A s \in Slots : decision[s] = "commit"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prepared, owner, decision>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Slots : Prepare(i, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Commit(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Abort(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Reopen(s)
    \/ Done

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A s \in Slots :
        owner[s] # "none" => (decision[s] = "commit" /\ prepared[s] = owner[s])
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network has two independent controller instances that share one pool of
access slots (each slot is a time-window grant on a lock). Allocating a slot uses two-phase commit:
an instance PREPAREs a free, unclaimed slot (taking a soft lock on it), then the coordinator either
COMMITs the slot to that instance (making it the owner) or ABORTs and releases the soft lock so the
slot can be reclaimed. A slot may only become owned through a committed prepare by that very instance.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a slot has an owner, that slot was committed and its owner is exactly the
instance that prepared it, so the same slot is never allocated to two instances.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od9m2p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Feeders == {"f1","f2"}
Cap == 4
Amounts == 1..3

VARIABLES alloc, req, phase, net

TypeOK ==
    /\ alloc \in [Feeders -> 0..Cap]
    /\ req \in [Feeders -> 0..Cap]
    /\ phase \in [Feeders -> {"idle","prep","committed","aborted"}]
    /\ net \subseteq (Feeders \X Amounts)

Total == alloc["f1"] + alloc["f2"]

Init ==
    /\ alloc = [f \in Feeders |-> 0]
    /\ req = [f \in Feeders |-> 0]
    /\ phase = [f \in Feeders |-> "idle"]
    /\ net = {}

Propose(f, a) ==
    /\ phase[f] = "idle"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![f] = "prep"]
    /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![f] = a]
    /\ net' = net \cup {<<f, a>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED alloc

Commit(f, a) ==
    /\ <<f, a>> \in net
    /\ phase[f] = "prep"
    /\ (Total - alloc[f]) + a <= Cap
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![f] = a]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![f] = "committed"]
    /\ net' = net \ {<<f, a>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED req

Abort(f, a) ==
    /\ <<f, a>> \in net
    /\ phase[f] = "prep"
    /\ (Total - alloc[f]) + a > Cap
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![f] = "aborted"]
    /\ net' = net \ {<<f, a>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, req>>

Release(f) ==
    /\ phase[f] = "committed"
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![f] = 0]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![f] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<req, net>>

Reset(f) ==
    /\ phase[f] = "aborted"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![f] = "idle"]
    /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![f] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, net>>

Done ==
    /\ \A f \in Feeders : phase[f] \in {"committed","aborted"}
    /\ net = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, req, phase, net>>

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Feeders, a \in Amounts : Propose(f, a)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders, a \in Amounts : Commit(f, a)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders, a \in Amounts : Abort(f, a)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : Release(f)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : Reset(f)
    \/ Done

WithinCap == Total <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT WithinCap
nl:
A power-grid load shedder allocates load across two feeders that share a bounded total capacity.
Allocations use two-phase commit over an asynchronous network whose messages can be reordered: the
coordinator PROPOSEs an amount for an idle feeder, emitting a prepare message into the network. The
network holds pending messages as an unordered pool, so any pending proposal may be resolved in any
order. A proposal is COMMITted only if the amount plus the load already committed on the other feeder
stays within total capacity; otherwise it is ABORTed. A committed feeder may later RELEASE its load
and an aborted feeder may RESET to idle.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total committed load across all feeders never exceeds the shared capacity.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od12m3p2t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Locs == {"bankA","bankB"}
Instances == {"n1","n2"}
Total == 3

VARIABLES stock, transit, leader, up

TypeOK ==
    /\ stock \in [Locs -> 0..Total]
    /\ transit \in 0..Total
    /\ leader \in Instances \cup {"none"}
    /\ up \subseteq Instances

Onhand == stock["bankA"] + stock["bankB"] + transit

Init ==
    /\ stock = [l \in Locs |-> IF l = "bankA" THEN 2 ELSE 1]
    /\ transit = 0
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ up = Instances

Elect(i) ==
    /\ i \in up
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ leader' = i
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, transit, up>>

Fail(i) ==
    /\ leader = i
    /\ leader' = "none"
    /\ up' = up \ {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, transit>>

Recover(i) ==
    /\ i \notin up
    /\ up' = up \cup {i}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, transit, leader>>

Ship(l) ==
    /\ leader # "none"
    /\ stock[l] > 0
    /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![l] = @ - 1]
    /\ transit' = transit + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up>>

Receive(l) ==
    /\ leader # "none"
    /\ transit > 0
    /\ transit' = transit - 1
    /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![l] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, up>>

Done ==
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ up = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, transit, leader, up>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Elect(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Fail(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Recover(i)
    \/ \E l \in Locs : Ship(l)
    \/ \E l \in Locs : Receive(l)
    \/ Done

Conservation == Onhand = Total
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker keeps units of blood across two bank locations, coordinated by two
server instances that share the one inventory pool. The instances run leader election with failover:
an up instance with no current leader is ELECTED leader; the leader may FAIL, dropping leadership and
going down, after which a surviving instance is elected (failover); a downed instance may RECOVER.
Only the current leader may move stock: it SHIPs a unit from a location into transit, and a unit in
transit is later RECEIVED at a location. Units are neither created nor destroyed while moving.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of blood units, counting those at locations plus those in transit,
stays constant.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od16m2p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Slots == {"s1","s2"}
Requesters == {"r1","r2"}
Units == {"dispA","dispB"}

VARIABLES votes, holder, reqBy, state

TypeOK ==
    /\ votes \in [Slots -> SUBSET Units]
    /\ holder \in [Slots -> Requesters \cup {"none"}]
    /\ reqBy \in [Slots -> Requesters \cup {"none"}]
    /\ state \in [Slots -> {"open","voting","committed","aborted"}]

Init ==
    /\ votes = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
    /\ holder = [s \in Slots |-> "none"]
    /\ reqBy = [s \in Slots |-> "none"]
    /\ state = [s \in Slots |-> "open"]

Open(r, s) ==
    /\ state[s] = "open"
    /\ reqBy' = [reqBy EXCEPT ![s] = r]
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![s] = "voting"]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED holder

Vote(u, s) ==
    /\ state[s] = "voting"
    /\ u \notin votes[s]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = @ \cup {u}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, reqBy, state>>

Commit(s) ==
    /\ state[s] = "voting"
    /\ votes[s] = Units
    /\ holder[s] = "none"
    /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![s] = reqBy[s]]
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![s] = "committed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, reqBy>>

Abort(s) ==
    /\ state[s] = "voting"
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![s] = "aborted"]
    /\ reqBy' = [reqBy EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED holder

Reopen(s) ==
    /\ state[s] = "aborted"
    /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![s] = "open"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, holder, reqBy>>

Done ==
    /\ \A s \in Slots : state[s] = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, holder, reqBy, state>>

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Requesters, s \in Slots : Open(r, s)
    \/ \E u \in Units, s \in Slots : Vote(u, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Commit(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Abort(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Reopen(s)
    \/ Done

NoDoubleDispense ==
    \A s \in Slots :
        holder[s] # "none" =>
            /\ state[s] = "committed"
            /\ votes[s] = Units
            /\ holder[s] = reqBy[s]
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleDispense
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser has two requester front-ends that share one pool of controlled-drug
dispensing slots, with two dispensing units acting as the participants in a two-phase commit. To claim
a slot a front-end OPENs it, recording itself as requester and moving the slot into voting; each
dispensing unit then VOTEs (acknowledges) the slot. Once both units have voted, the coordinator COMMITs,
assigning the slot's holder to the requester that opened it. A slot in voting may instead ABORT (e.g. a
unit times out), clearing the requester, and an aborted slot may REOPEN for a fresh claim.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a slot has a holder, it was committed with both units' votes and its holder is
exactly the front-end that opened it, so no slot is ever dispensed to two requesters.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m6p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Planes == {"p1","p2"}
LeaseLen == 2
MaxClock == 3

VARIABLES onRunway, leaseRem, clock, adminGrant

TypeOK ==
    /\ onRunway \in Planes \cup {"none"}
    /\ leaseRem \in [Planes -> 0..LeaseLen]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ adminGrant \in Planes \cup {"none"}

Init ==
    /\ onRunway = "none"
    /\ leaseRem = [p \in Planes |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ adminGrant = "none"

Acquire(p) ==
    /\ onRunway = "none"
    /\ leaseRem[p] = 0
    /\ onRunway' = p
    /\ leaseRem' = [leaseRem EXCEPT ![p] = LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, adminGrant>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ leaseRem' = [p \in Planes |-> IF leaseRem[p] > 0 THEN leaseRem[p] - 1 ELSE 0]
    /\ onRunway' = IF /\ onRunway # "none"
                      /\ leaseRem[onRunway] <= 1
                      /\ adminGrant # onRunway
                   THEN "none" ELSE onRunway
    /\ UNCHANGED adminGrant

Release(p) ==
    /\ onRunway = p
    /\ onRunway' = "none"
    /\ leaseRem' = [leaseRem EXCEPT ![p] = 0]
    /\ adminGrant' = IF adminGrant = p THEN "none" ELSE adminGrant
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

AdminOverride(p) ==
    /\ onRunway' = p
    /\ leaseRem' = [leaseRem EXCEPT ![p] = LeaseLen]
    /\ adminGrant' = p
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

Done ==
    /\ onRunway = "none"
    /\ clock = MaxClock
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onRunway, leaseRem, clock, adminGrant>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Planes : Acquire(p)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E p \in Planes : Release(p)
    \/ \E p \in Planes : AdminOverride(p)
    \/ Done

RunwayAuth ==
    onRunway # "none" =>
        (leaseRem[onRunway] > 0 \/ adminGrant = onRunway)
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RunwayAuth
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator grants exclusive use of a single runway via time-limited leases. A plane
ACQUIREs the runway only when it is free, receiving a lease with a fixed remaining time. A global TICK
advances the clock and decrements every outstanding lease. When the holder's lease has run out and it is
not covered by an admin grant, the runway EXPIREs and is released; a holder may also voluntarily RELEASE.
A privileged controller may issue an ADMIN OVERRIDE, seizing the runway for a chosen plane regardless of
the current holder or lease and marking it admin-granted.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a plane occupies the runway, it either holds a still-valid lease or is the
plane currently covered by the admin override.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od18m2p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Updates == {"u1","u2","u3"}
MaxCap == 3

VARIABLES record, committed, prepared, capacity

TypeOK ==
    /\ record \subseteq Updates
    /\ committed \subseteq Updates
    /\ prepared \subseteq Updates
    /\ capacity \in 1..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ record = {}
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ prepared = {}
    /\ capacity = 2

Propose(u) ==
    /\ u \notin prepared
    /\ u \notin committed
    /\ prepared' = prepared \cup {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, committed, capacity>>

Commit(u) ==
    /\ u \in prepared
    /\ Cardinality(record) < capacity
    /\ committed' = committed \cup {u}
    /\ record' = record \cup {u}
    /\ prepared' = prepared \ {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED capacity

Abort(u) ==
    /\ u \in prepared
    /\ prepared' = prepared \ {u}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, committed, capacity>>

ChangeCapacity(c) ==
    /\ c \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ c >= Cardinality(record)
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, committed, prepared>>

Done ==
    /\ prepared = {}
    /\ committed \cup prepared = Updates \/ Cardinality(record) = capacity
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, committed, prepared, capacity>>

Next ==
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Propose(u)
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Commit(u)
    \/ \E u \in Updates : Abort(u)
    \/ \E c \in 1..MaxCap : ChangeCapacity(c)
    \/ Done

NoLostUpdate == committed \subseteq record
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network maintains one shared configuration record (the set of applied lock-policy
updates). Front-ends push updates through two-phase commit: an update is PROPOSEd (entering the prepared
set), then either COMMITted, which both marks it committed and persists it into the shared record, or
ABORTed, dropping it from prepared. The record has a capacity that CHANGES at runtime as lock hardware is
added or retired, but capacity may never be reduced below the number of updates already persisted, so a
runtime capacity change can never evict an applied update. A commit is only allowed while the record has
spare capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every update the coordinator has committed is present in the shared record; no committed
update is ever lost.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od12m3p2t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Centers == {"cA","cB","cC"}
Servers == {"s1","s2"}
Total == 3

VARIABLES bank, reserved, leader, alive

TypeOK ==
    /\ bank \in [Centers -> 0..Total]
    /\ reserved \in 0..Total
    /\ leader \in Servers \cup {"none"}
    /\ alive \subseteq Servers

Onhand == bank["cA"] + bank["cB"] + bank["cC"] + reserved

Init ==
    /\ bank = [c \in Centers |-> 1]
    /\ reserved = 0
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ alive = Servers

Elect(s) ==
    /\ s \in alive
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ leader' = s
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bank, reserved, alive>>

StepDown(s) ==
    /\ leader = s
    /\ leader' = "none"
    /\ alive' = alive \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bank, reserved>>

Recover(s) ==
    /\ s \notin alive
    /\ alive' = alive \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bank, reserved, leader>>

Reserve(c) ==
    /\ leader # "none"
    /\ bank[c] > 0
    /\ bank' = [bank EXCEPT ![c] = @ - 1]
    /\ reserved' = reserved + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive>>

Commit(c) ==
    /\ leader # "none"
    /\ reserved > 0
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ bank' = [bank EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive>>

AdminReserve(c) ==
    /\ bank[c] > 0
    /\ bank' = [bank EXCEPT ![c] = @ - 1]
    /\ reserved' = reserved + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive>>

Done ==
    /\ leader = "none"
    /\ alive = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bank, reserved, leader, alive>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Servers : Elect(s)
    \/ \E s \in Servers : StepDown(s)
    \/ \E s \in Servers : Recover(s)
    \/ \E c \in Centers : Reserve(c)
    \/ \E c \in Centers : Commit(c)
    \/ \E c \in Centers : AdminReserve(c)
    \/ Done

Conservation == Onhand = Total
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker spread over three centers uses leader election with failover to coordinate
transfers. An alive server with no leader is ELECTED; the leader may STEP DOWN (failover), and a downed
server may RECOVER. Under a leader, a unit is RESERVEd out of a center into a shared reserved holding, and
a reserved unit is later COMMITted into some center. A privileged administrator may ADMIN-RESERVE a unit
out of a center directly, bypassing the need for a current leader. No transfer ever creates or destroys a
unit; units only move between centers and the reserved holding.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of units, summed over all centers plus the reserved holding, stays constant.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od9m5p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Slots == {"s1","s2"}
Feeders == {"f1","f2"}
Controllers == {"c1","c2","c3"}
Quorum == 2
MaxCap == 2

VARIABLES holders, voters, pendingBy, capacity

TypeOK ==
    /\ holders \in [Slots -> SUBSET Feeders]
    /\ voters \in [Slots -> SUBSET Controllers]
    /\ pendingBy \in [Slots -> Feeders \cup {"none"}]
    /\ capacity \in 1..MaxCap

Granted == {s \in Slots : holders[s] # {}}

Init ==
    /\ holders = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
    /\ voters = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
    /\ pendingBy = [s \in Slots |-> "none"]
    /\ capacity = 1

Request(f, s) ==
    /\ holders[s] = {}
    /\ pendingBy[s] = "none"
    /\ pendingBy' = [pendingBy EXCEPT ![s] = f]
    /\ voters' = [voters EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holders, capacity>>

CastVote(c, s) ==
    /\ pendingBy[s] # "none"
    /\ c \notin voters[s]
    /\ voters' = [voters EXCEPT ![s] = @ \cup {c}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holders, pendingBy, capacity>>

Grant(s) ==
    /\ pendingBy[s] # "none"
    /\ Cardinality(voters[s]) >= Quorum
    /\ holders[s] = {}
    /\ Cardinality(Granted) < capacity
    /\ holders' = [holders EXCEPT ![s] = {pendingBy[s]}]
    /\ pendingBy' = [pendingBy EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
    /\ voters' = [voters EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED capacity

Cancel(s) ==
    /\ pendingBy[s] # "none"
    /\ pendingBy' = [pendingBy EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
    /\ voters' = [voters EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holders, capacity>>

Release(s) ==
    /\ holders[s] # {}
    /\ holders' = [holders EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<voters, pendingBy, capacity>>

ChangeCapacity(k) ==
    /\ k \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ k >= Cardinality(Granted)
    /\ capacity' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holders, voters, pendingBy>>

Done ==
    /\ \A s \in Slots : pendingBy[s] = "none"
    /\ Cardinality(Granted) = capacity
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holders, voters, pendingBy, capacity>>

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Feeders, s \in Slots : Request(f, s)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, s \in Slots : CastVote(c, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Grant(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Cancel(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)
    \/ \E k \in 1..MaxCap : ChangeCapacity(k)
    \/ Done

NoDoubleHold == \A s \in Slots : Cardinality(holders[s]) <= 1
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleHold
nl:
A power-grid load shedder assigns shedding slots to feeders, and every assignment must clear quorum voting
by a panel of three controllers. A feeder REQUESTs a free slot, controllers CAST votes for the pending
request, and once a quorum (at least two) has voted the slot is GRANTed to the requesting feeder, provided
the total number of granted slots is still under the current capacity. A pending request may be CANCELled,
and a granted slot may be RELEASEd back to free. The system capacity CHANGES at runtime as grid conditions
shift, but never below the number of slots already granted.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no slot is ever held by more than one feeder at the same time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od10m2p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Blocks == {"b1","b2"}
Trains == {"t1","t2"}
MaxGen == 2

VARIABLES curGen, grants, authOf, authGen, occ

TypeOK ==
    /\ curGen \in 0..MaxGen
    /\ grants \in [Blocks -> {"none"} \cup (Trains \X (0..MaxGen))]
    /\ authOf \in [Blocks -> Trains \cup {"none"}]
    /\ authGen \in [Blocks -> 0..MaxGen]
    /\ occ \in [Blocks -> Trains \cup {"none"}]

Init ==
    /\ curGen = 0
    /\ grants = [b \in Blocks |-> "none"]
    /\ authOf = [b \in Blocks |-> "none"]
    /\ authGen = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]
    /\ occ = [b \in Blocks |-> "none"]

IssueGrant(b, t) ==
    /\ grants[b] = "none"
    /\ grants' = [grants EXCEPT ![b] = <<t, curGen>>]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<curGen, authOf, authGen, occ>>

DeliverGrant(b) ==
    /\ grants[b] # "none"
    /\ grants[b][2] = curGen
    /\ occ[b] = "none"
    /\ authOf' = [authOf EXCEPT ![b] = grants[b][1]]
    /\ authGen' = [authGen EXCEPT ![b] = curGen]
    /\ grants' = [grants EXCEPT ![b] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<curGen, occ>>

DropStale(b) ==
    /\ grants[b] # "none"
    /\ grants[b][2] < curGen
    /\ grants' = [grants EXCEPT ![b] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<curGen, authOf, authGen, occ>>

Bump ==
    /\ curGen < MaxGen
    /\ curGen' = curGen + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, authOf, authGen, occ>>

Enter(b, t) ==
    /\ authOf[b] = t
    /\ authGen[b] = curGen
    /\ occ[b] = "none"
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![b] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<curGen, grants, authOf, authGen>>

Leave(b) ==
    /\ occ[b] # "none"
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![b] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<curGen, grants, authOf, authGen>>

Done ==
    /\ curGen = MaxGen
    /\ \A b \in Blocks : grants[b] = "none" /\ occ[b] = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<curGen, grants, authOf, authGen, occ>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Blocks, t \in Trains : IssueGrant(b, t)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : DeliverGrant(b)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : DropStale(b)
    \/ Bump
    \/ \E b \in Blocks, t \in Trains : Enter(b, t)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Leave(b)
    \/ Done

OccAuthorized == \A b \in Blocks : occ[b] # "none" => authOf[b] = occ[b]
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OccAuthorized
nl:
A subway signalling block system authorizes trains to enter track blocks through a two-phase grant protocol
over an asynchronous link whose messages arrive out of order. A dispatcher ISSUEs a grant for a block to a
train, tagged with the current authorization generation; because links reorder, each block's pending grant is
delivered independently. A grant is DELIVERed and applied only if its generation still matches the current
generation, otherwise it is DROPPED as stale. A reconfiguration BUMPs the generation, invalidating older
grants. A train may ENTER a block only while it holds the block's current-generation authorization, and later
LEAVEs.
SAFETY PROPERTY: any occupied block is occupied only by the train that currently holds that block's authorization.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od0m4p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

Workers == {"w1","w2"}
MaxLen == 3

VARIABLES queue, registered, crashed, inOR

TypeOK ==
    /\ queue \in Seq(Workers)
    /\ Len(queue) <= MaxLen
    /\ registered \subseteq Workers
    /\ crashed \subseteq Workers
    /\ inOR \in Workers \cup {"none"}

Init ==
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ registered = {}
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ inOR = "none"

Register(w) ==
    /\ w \notin registered
    /\ w \notin crashed
    /\ registered' = registered \cup {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, crashed, inOR>>

Crash(w) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ crashed' = {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, registered, inOR>>

Enqueue(w) ==
    /\ w \in registered
    /\ w \notin crashed
    /\ Len(queue) < MaxLen
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, w)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<registered, crashed, inOR>>

StartOR ==
    /\ inOR = "none"
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ inOR' = Head(queue)
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<registered, crashed>>

FinishOR ==
    /\ inOR # "none"
    /\ inOR' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, registered, crashed>>

Done ==
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ inOR = "none"
    /\ registered = Workers
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, registered, crashed, inOR>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Register(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Crash(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Enqueue(w)
    \/ StartOR
    \/ FinishOR
    \/ Done

QueueAuthorized ==
    /\ \A i \in DOMAIN queue : queue[i] \in registered
    /\ (inOR # "none" => inOR \in registered)
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT QueueAuthorized
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler feeds surgery requests through a bounded work queue with backpressure.
Surgeon workstations must first REGISTER before they may act. A registered, non-crashed workstation may
ENQUEUE a request, but only while the queue is below its maximum length, so a full queue exerts backpressure
and blocks new submissions. The scheduler STARTs the next request into the single operating room and later
FINISHes it. Any one workstation may CRASH silently, after which it can no longer enqueue, though requests it
already submitted remain queued.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every request waiting in the queue or currently in the operating room was submitted by a
registered workstation.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m7p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Drones == {"d1","d2"}
Sectors == {"s1","s2"}
MaxVer == 2

VARIABLES owner, ver, snap, claims

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Sectors -> Drones \cup {"free"}]
    /\ ver \in [Sectors -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ snap \in [Drones -> [Sectors -> 0..MaxVer]]
    /\ claims \subseteq (Sectors \X Drones)

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Sectors |-> "free"]
    /\ ver = [s \in Sectors |-> 0]
    /\ snap = [d \in Drones |-> [s \in Sectors |-> 0]]
    /\ claims = {}

Read(d, s) ==
    /\ snap[d][s] # ver[s]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d][s] = ver[s]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ver, claims>>

Claim(d, s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = "free"
    /\ ver[s] % 2 = 0
    /\ ver[s] < MaxVer
    /\ snap[d][s] = ver[s]
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = d]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![s] = @ + 1]
    /\ claims' = claims \cup {<<s, d>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

Release(s) ==
    /\ owner[s] # "free"
    /\ ver[s] % 2 = 1
    /\ ver[s] < MaxVer
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = "free"]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![s] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, claims>>

Done ==
    /\ \A s \in Sectors : owner[s] = "free" /\ ver[s] = MaxVer
    /\ \A d \in Drones, s \in Sectors : snap[d][s] = ver[s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, ver, snap, claims>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones, s \in Sectors : Read(d, s)
    \/ \E d \in Drones, s \in Sectors : Claim(d, s)
    \/ \E s \in Sectors : Release(s)
    \/ Done

CASConsistent ==
    \A s \in Sectors :
        /\ (owner[s] = "free") <=> (ver[s] % 2 = 0)
        /\ (owner[s] # "free" => <<s, owner[s]>> \in claims)
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CASConsistent
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm claims sectors through a compare-and-swap register per sector. Each sector
holds an owner ("free" or a drone) plus a version counter; the register is free at even versions and owned at
odd versions. A drone first READs a sector to snapshot its version. It may CLAIM a free sector only when its
snapshot still equals the live version, atomically taking ownership and bumping the version to odd. An owner
later RELEASEs, bumping the version back to even. A drone may be slow: it can act on an old snapshot, but the
compare-and-swap then fails to match and the claim is refused, so a slow drone cannot steal a sector.
SAFETY PROPERTY: a sector is free exactly when its version is even and owned exactly when its version is odd,
and any owned sector's owner has a recorded claim, so the same sector is never doubly allocated.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m6p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

Slots == {"r1","r2"}
Planes == {"p1","p2"}
LeaseLen == 2
MaxClock == 3
MaxCap == 2

VARIABLES lessee, expiry, clock, capacity

TypeOK ==
    /\ lessee \in [Slots -> Planes \cup {"none"}]
    /\ expiry \in [Slots -> 0..LeaseLen]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ capacity \in 1..MaxCap

Active == {s \in Slots : lessee[s] # "none"}

Init ==
    /\ lessee = [s \in Slots |-> "none"]
    /\ expiry = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ capacity = 1

Acquire(p, s) ==
    /\ lessee[s] = "none"
    /\ expiry[s] = 0
    /\ Cardinality(Active) < capacity
    /\ lessee' = [lessee EXCEPT ![s] = p]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![s] = LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, capacity>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ expiry' = [s \in Slots |-> IF expiry[s] > 0 THEN expiry[s] - 1 ELSE 0]
    /\ lessee' = [s \in Slots |-> IF expiry[s] <= 1 THEN "none" ELSE lessee[s]]
    /\ UNCHANGED capacity

Renew(s) ==
    /\ lessee[s] # "none"
    /\ expiry[s] > 0
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![s] = LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lessee, clock, capacity>>

Release(s) ==
    /\ lessee[s] # "none"
    /\ lessee' = [lessee EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, capacity>>

ChangeCapacity(k) ==
    /\ k \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ k >= Cardinality(Active)
    /\ capacity' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lessee, expiry, clock>>

Done ==
    /\ Active = {}
    /\ clock = MaxClock
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lessee, expiry, clock, capacity>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Planes, s \in Slots : Acquire(p, s)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Renew(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Release(s)
    \/ \E k \in 1..MaxCap : ChangeCapacity(k)
    \/ Done

LeaseConsistent == \A s \in Slots : (lessee[s] # "none") <=> (expiry[s] > 0)
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT LeaseConsistent
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator leases multiple runway slots to planes with time-limited leases. A plane
ACQUIREs a free slot only while the number of active leases is below the current capacity, receiving a lease
with a fixed remaining time. A global TICK advances the clock and decrements every lease; a slot whose lease
reaches zero is atomically freed. A holder may RENEW its lease before it expires, or RELEASE the slot early.
The system CHANGES capacity at runtime as the airport reconfigures, but never below the number of slots
currently leased.
SAFETY PROPERTY: a slot has a lessee exactly when its lease time is positive, so no slot is left doubly
allocated across an expiry.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od19m2p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Books == {"b1","b2"}
Members == {"m1","m2"}
Branches == {"x1","x2"}

VARIABLES resOf, proposer, votes, crashed, authorized

TypeOK ==
    /\ resOf \in [Books -> Members \cup {"none"}]
    /\ proposer \in [Books -> Members \cup {"none"}]
    /\ votes \in [Books -> SUBSET Branches]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Branches
    /\ authorized \subseteq Members

Init ==
    /\ resOf = [b \in Books |-> "none"]
    /\ proposer = [b \in Books |-> "none"]
    /\ votes = [b \in Books |-> {}]
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ authorized = {}

Register(m) ==
    /\ m \notin authorized
    /\ authorized' = authorized \cup {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resOf, proposer, votes, crashed>>

Propose(m, b) ==
    /\ m \in authorized
    /\ resOf[b] = "none"
    /\ proposer[b] = "none"
    /\ proposer' = [proposer EXCEPT ![b] = m]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resOf, crashed, authorized>>

Vote(x, b) ==
    /\ x \notin crashed
    /\ proposer[b] # "none"
    /\ x \notin votes[b]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = @ \cup {x}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resOf, proposer, crashed, authorized>>

Crash(x) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ crashed' = {x}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resOf, proposer, votes, authorized>>

Commit(b) ==
    /\ proposer[b] # "none"
    /\ resOf[b] = "none"
    /\ votes[b] = Branches \ crashed
    /\ resOf' = [resOf EXCEPT ![b] = proposer[b]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<proposer, votes, crashed, authorized>>

Abort(b) ==
    /\ proposer[b] # "none"
    /\ resOf[b] = "none"
    /\ proposer' = [proposer EXCEPT ![b] = "none"]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![b] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resOf, crashed, authorized>>

Done ==
    /\ \A b \in Books : resOf[b] # "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<resOf, proposer, votes, crashed, authorized>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Members : Register(m)
    \/ \E m \in Members, b \in Books : Propose(m, b)
    \/ \E x \in Branches, b \in Books : Vote(x, b)
    \/ \E x \in Branches : Crash(x)
    \/ \E b \in Books : Commit(b)
    \/ \E b \in Books : Abort(b)
    \/ Done

ReservationAuthorized ==
    \A b \in Books :
        /\ (proposer[b] # "none" => proposer[b] \in authorized)
        /\ (resOf[b] # "none" => resOf[b] \in authorized)
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ReservationAuthorized
nl:
A library book-reservation system commits reservations through two-phase commit across branch nodes. A patron
must first REGISTER to become an authorized member. An authorized member PROPOSEs a reservation on a free book,
and each branch node that has not crashed VOTEs to acknowledge it. Once every non-crashed branch has voted, the
coordinator COMMITs, recording the member as the book's holder; a proposal may instead ABORT and clear. Any one
branch node may CRASH silently, after which it casts no further votes, but the remaining branches can still reach
a decision.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every proposed and every committed reservation belongs to an authorized member, so no
unauthorized patron ever acts.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m6p0t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Drones == {"d1","d2"}
Controllers == {"c1","c2"}
LeaseLen == 2
MaxClock == 3

VARIABLES holder, leaseRem, clock, grantedBy

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Drones \cup {"none"}
    /\ leaseRem \in [Drones -> 0..LeaseLen]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ grantedBy \in Controllers \cup {"none"}

Init ==
    /\ holder = "none"
    /\ leaseRem = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ grantedBy = "none"

Acquire(c, d) ==
    /\ holder = "none"
    /\ leaseRem[d] = 0
    /\ holder' = d
    /\ leaseRem' = [leaseRem EXCEPT ![d] = LeaseLen]
    /\ grantedBy' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ leaseRem' = [d \in Drones |-> IF leaseRem[d] > 0 THEN leaseRem[d] - 1 ELSE 0]
    /\ holder' = IF holder # "none" /\ leaseRem[holder] <= 1 THEN "none" ELSE holder
    /\ grantedBy' = IF holder # "none" /\ leaseRem[holder] <= 1 THEN "none" ELSE grantedBy
    /\ UNCHANGED <<>>

Renew ==
    /\ holder # "none"
    /\ leaseRem[holder] > 0
    /\ leaseRem' = [leaseRem EXCEPT ![holder] = LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, clock, grantedBy>>

Release ==
    /\ holder # "none"
    /\ leaseRem' = [leaseRem EXCEPT ![holder] = 0]
    /\ holder' = "none"
    /\ grantedBy' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

Done ==
    /\ holder = "none"
    /\ clock = MaxClock
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, leaseRem, clock, grantedBy>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, d \in Drones : Acquire(c, d)
    \/ Tick
    \/ Renew
    \/ Release
    \/ Done

RelayLeaseValid == holder # "none" => leaseRem[holder] > 0
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RelayLeaseValid
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm shares one critical relay channel, coordinated by two independent
controller instances that draw from the same drone pool. Access to the relay is granted by time-limited
lease: either controller may ACQUIRE the free relay for a drone, recording which controller granted it and
giving it a lease with fixed remaining time. A global TICK advances the clock and decrements the lease; when
the lease reaches zero the relay is atomically freed. The holding drone may RENEW its lease before it expires
or RELEASE the relay early.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a drone holds the relay, its lease time is still positive, so the single relay is
never held past its lease.

cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A print shop job spooler applies configuration updates to one shared spool record using two-phase commit over
an asynchronous network whose messages arrive out of order. An update is PROPOSEd, placing a prepare message on
the network. When the prepare message is processed, the participant persists the update into the shared record
and replaces it with a ready message (ACK-PREPARE). The coordinator then COMMITs the update once its ready
message is seen, marking it committed. A pending prepare may instead be ABORTed and dropped without persisting.
Because the network reorders, prepare and ready messages for different updates may be handled in any order.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every committed update has already been persisted into the shared record, so no committed
update is ever lost.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od12m1p3t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

Nodes == {"n1","n2","n3"}
Slots == {"g1","g2"}
MaxAdmin == 2

VARIABLES token, serving, requested, adminCount

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Nodes
    /\ serving \in [Slots -> Nodes \cup {"none"}]
    /\ requested \in [Slots -> SUBSET Nodes]
    /\ adminCount \in 0..MaxAdmin

NextNode(n) ==
    CASE n = "n1" -> "n2"
      [] n = "n2" -> "n3"
      [] OTHER    -> "n1"

Init ==
    /\ token = "n1"
    /\ serving = [s \in Slots |-> "none"]
    /\ requested = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
    /\ adminCount = 0

Request(n, s) ==
    /\ n \notin requested[s]
    /\ requested' = [requested EXCEPT ![s] = @ \cup {n}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, serving, adminCount>>

StartServe(s) ==
    /\ serving[s] = "none"
    /\ token \in requested[s]
    /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![s] = token]
    /\ requested' = [requested EXCEPT ![s] = @ \ {token}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, adminCount>>

StopServe(s) ==
    /\ serving[s] # "none"
    /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![s] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, requested, adminCount>>

PassToken ==
    /\ \A s \in Slots : serving[s] # token
    /\ token' = NextNode(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<serving, requested, adminCount>>

AdminOverride(n) ==
    /\ adminCount < MaxAdmin
    /\ token' = n
    /\ serving' = [s \in Slots |-> "none"]
    /\ adminCount' = adminCount + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED requested

Done ==
    /\ \A s \in Slots : serving[s] = "none" /\ requested[s] = Nodes
    /\ adminCount = MaxAdmin
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, serving, requested, adminCount>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, s \in Slots : Request(n, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : StartServe(s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : StopServe(s)
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : AdminOverride(n)
    \/ Done

ServeExclusive == \A s \in Slots : serving[s] # "none" => serving[s] = token
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ServeExclusive
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker grants exclusive access to storage slots using a token ring over three nodes.
A single token circulates; only the node currently holding the token may begin SERVING a slot. Any node may
REQUEST to serve a slot, joining that slot's waiting set. The token holder may START serving a requested slot,
and must STOP serving before the token moves on. The token is PASSED to the next node in the ring only when the
holder is not currently serving any slot. A privileged administrator may ADMIN-OVERRIDE, seizing the token to a
chosen node and clearing all in-progress service; overrides are limited in number.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a slot is being served, it is being served by the node that currently holds the token,
so no slot is ever served (allocated) by two nodes at once.
